items.question: How long does development take?
items.answer: Landing page — 5–10 days. Corporate site — from 3 weeks. Online store with integrations — from 4 weeks. Exact deadlines go into the contract after the brief.

items.question: We already have a site and a CRM, but they don't talk. Is that your job?
items.answer: Yes, that's our core work. We don't rebuild everything from scratch — we connect what already runs: site, CRM, accounting, marketplaces, telephony, shipping.

items.question: Why more expensive than a freelancer?
items.answer: Because the price includes a contract, a 12-month warranty, configured analytics and support. The warranty means we fix defects in the delivered code free of charge for 12 months, while new features are built by separate agreement. A freelancer is cheaper right up until they disappear — then you pay twice for the same thing.

items.question: What does post-launch support include?
items.answer: First month — free fixes and consulting. After that, by agreement. We don't disappear once we're paid.

items.question: Do you hand over access?
items.answer: Yes, all of it, immediately. Site, domain, hosting, analytics — they're yours. We don't hold clients hostage.

items.question: Do you work with existing sites?
items.answer: Yes, that's most of our work. We take a site in any condition — extend it, fix it, integrate it with everything else.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. For larger projects — staged, with each stage's deliverable fixed in the contract. The next payment only comes after you've accepted the previous stage. We don't ask for money for the next step until the current one is closed.

items.question: What if I need something non-standard?
items.answer: Message us on Telegram and we'll talk it through. We've built integrations with Vapi, Binotel, SalesDrive, KeyCRM, Checkbox and Nova Poshta. Chances are we've done it already.
